newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen moves to cut 80 pct illiteracy.
newsitem.headline: Yemen moves to cut 80 pct illiteracy.

text.p: Yemen's government has passed a draft resolution to stamp out illiteracy estimated at 80 percent among the country's 16.7 million people, an official Yemeni source said on Wednesday.
"The resolution aims at the eradication of illiteracy and the establishment of a supreme committee for adult education," the source said.
He said the draft had been sent to parliament for approval.
